name: so.blackforge/mcp
description: Crypto market data: order book depth, liquidity lifetimes and taker flow on the major spot venues

environmentVariables.name: BLACKFORGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: BlackForge API key. Every tool except blackforge_catalog requires one.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKFORGE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.blackforge.so.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKFORGE_REALTIME_URL
environmentVariables.description: Realtime host for live formulas and live order book reads. Defaults to https://realtime.blackforge.so.
